docstring:
The first open case of Erdős Problem 535 is $r = 3$: there should exist $c > 0$ such that
$f_3(N) \leq N^{c/\log\log N}$ for all sufficiently large $N$.
references: [Er64](https://users.renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1964-10.pdf) P. Erdős, _On a problem in elementary number theory and a combinatorial problem_. Math. Comp. (1964), 644–646.
[AbHa70](https://doi.org/10.1112/blms/2.3.324) H. L. Abbott and D. Hanson, _An extremal problem in number theory_. Bull. London Math. Soc. (1970), 324–326.
[Er73](https://users.renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1973-21.pdf) P. Erdős, _Problems and results on combinatorial number theory_, in *A Survey of Combinatorial Theory*, North-Holland, 1973.
type_pretty: ∃ c > 0, ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(Erdos535.f 3 N) ≤ ↑N ^ (c / Real.log (Real.log ↑N))
